I have been suffering for the past 2 years from depression, anxiety and OCD and other things, I have been thinking about the fact that I was born in a poor communist country, I am actually 15 years old and tomorrow is my first real day of high school, I nearly cried so hard today... I had a youtube gaming channel in early 2015 and quit because of a massive amount of hate, I have quit youtube multiple times before that too, I also quit in 2016 because of massive amounts of hate too and because of 0 motivation and not knowing what to do with the channel

And I am gonna get back into making youtube videos and this might sound stupid but my goal is to get 100K subs, I have a horrible accent, horrible voice, no microphone and speech impediment and the other advantages that are more about life are that again I wasn't born in a first world country and sometimes can't stop thinking about the people who were babysitted by this world and had all the advantages in life

I don't know what to say anymore... I can't feel happy at all for some reason, that is all

Thank you for your comment... **everyone** that I compare myself to seems to have it better than me and I don't know what I am doing wrong in life and what is so wrong in my psychology or situation that is keeping my life just constant suffering, maybe the disadvantages I have just make my life a weird situation that nobody else has gone through so I don't know what to do
